notes.title: Two new Fighting Fantasy Classics gamebooks announced!
notes.content:
Our [i]Fighting Fantasy Classics[/i] library will be getting two new additions, hailing from the masters themselves, Ian Livingstone and Steve Jackson. [i]Temple of Terror[/i] and [i]Creature of Havoc[/i] will be released later this year!

If you enjoy the choice-based adventure narrative in [i]The Warlock of Firetop Mountain[/i], then maybe check out FFC, where you'll get to adventure through the pirate text adventure, [i]Bloodbones[/i], for free!

[h3]Fighting Fantasy Classics:[/h3] https://store.steampowered.com/app/856880/Fighting_Fantasy_Classics/

Our new titles will take place in Allansia, the same world as [i]The Warlock of Firetop Mountain[/i], and have more than a few passing references to locations and events in each.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25736678/f71d27bea2387d821ceeea18227c25f1aad727ce.png[/img]\
[b]Written by Steve Jackson[/b]

[i]Are you ready for the most unusual Fighting Fantasy adventure yet?

You begin this adventure not knowing where you are or who you are. All you know is that you are some kind of creature of instinct, understanding little. During the course of the adventure, it may be possible for you to begin to control your bestial nature, to find out more about yourself, and even to learn your destiny. But even if you know all this, success is by no means certain, for the traps and terrors of Trolltooth Pass are many ... Are you ready — to become the Creature of Havoc?[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25736678/ac478e9d59cb46708b7fd445fb0035dae45737dd.png[/img]
[b]Written by Ian Livingstone[/b]

[i]The dark, twisted power of the young Malbordus is reaching its zenith!

All he needs now is to retrieve the five dragon artefacts which have been hidden for centuries in the lost city of Vatos, somewhere in the Desert of Skulls. Each day that passes brings him closer to them and only YOU can stop him! YOUR mission is to reach the lost city before Malbordus and destroy the treasures he seeks. But beware! Each step you take leads you closer to your doom ...[/i]

[h3]Two dice, [strike]a pencil and an eraser[/strike] are all you need to make your journey. YOU decide which route to follow, which dangers to risk and which foes to fight![/h3]

notes.title: New Fighting Fantasy Classics 25% OFF!
notes.content:
TRIAL OF CHAMPIONS has arrived! The sequel to [i]Deathtrap Dungeon[/i] joins a stellar roster of fantasy adventures in [i]Fighting Fantasy Classics[/i] - the ultimate library of text-based role playing games. And to celebrate, it's 25% OFF! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/897190/Trial_of_Champions/]Check it out here.[/url]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33039573/a6d64fdadb1fcc1c90a0c798cac92a41bbce8ed9.png[/img]

[i]Trial of Champions[/i] sees you delve into the dread corridors of Baron Sukumvit’s terrible challenge for a second stab at glory. But beware! The Trial will be even more devilishly difficult this time as you begin your adventure having been captured and sold into slavery! With nothing to prepare you for this arduous adventure but your SKILL, LUCK and STAMINA, you must explore the deadly labyrinth beneath Fang. For only by triumphing in the Trial can you win back your freedom from Baron Sukumvit’s evil brother – Lord Carnuss.

Will it be enough?!

Find out for yourself and pick up this classic title [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/897190/Trial_of_Champions/]while it's just 2.99 USD.[/url]

Also joining the [i]Fighting Fantasy Classics[/i] shelf is another old favourite – Steve Jackson’s [i]House of Hell[/i]. We’ve remastered this title for the [i]Fighting Fantasy Classics[/i] library, so it can take its rightful place amongst your collection. It is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/897180/House_of_Hell_Fighting_Fantasy_Classics/]also 25% OFF[/url] for a limited time. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33039573/2e02525bf6cbcfc88d0dbeb0a2e7103be93af2fc.png[/img]

[i]House of Hell’s[/i] addition to the library comes with a handful of updates including:
[list]
[*] Adventure Sheet now includes 'Fear' mechanic. 
[*] Knowledge Sheet to track the clues you discover.
[*] Tim Sell’s original artwork, as well as coloured editions of each piece.
[*] [i]Haunted Hallways[/i] ambient track added.
[*] Achievements added for both [i]Trial of Champions[/i] and [i]House of Hell[/i].
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33039573/aaf8f602b920bdc08fb7f9df81eeeee1bd82499c.png[/img]

Whether you're heading into the depths of the labyrinth beneath the city of Fang, or braving the haunted halls of the House of Drumer, may LUCK be with you and your STAMINA never fail!

notes.title: Fighting Fantasy Classics are coming!
notes.content:
As part of our $40k Stretch Goal for [i]The Warlock of Firetop Mountain[/i] Kickstarter we promised a classic version of TWOFM using our older [i]Gamebook Adventures Engine[/i]. It’s taken a while but we can now proudly announce that it will be available in 2018. Not only that but we have big plans for Fighting Fantasy and will be adapting a number of your old favourites in that old engine too!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25736678/47ef17233bdf27263ce49bdc7f6b42ee34ba2619.jpg[/img]

Press Release: Wednesday 13th December

[h1]New Digital Collection of Classic Fighting Fantasy Gamebooks in the Works [/h1]

Tin Man Games are currently developing [i]Fighting Fantasy Classics[/i], a digital library app for iOS, Android, PC and Mac, that will collect many of the gamebooks from the ever-popular [i]Fighting Fantasy[/i] series. The original adventures, written and presented by Ian Livingstone and Steve Jackson, are being converted to a digital gamebook format. Combat and skill rolls will be resolved by rolling realistic 3D dice, and the famous Adventure sheet, normally found at the front of the books, functions in the game via an autofill system.

The library will debut early 2018 and will feature [i]Fighting Fantasy[/i] titles previously released by Tin Man Games, along with new adaptations previously unseen in Tin Man’s gamebook engine. Favourites such as [i]The Warlock of Firetop Mountain, The Citadel of Chaos[/i], and [i]City of Thieves[/i] will join [i]Bloodbones, Caverns of the Snow Witch, Island of the Lizard King and The Forest of Doom[/i].

Neil Rennison, Creative Director for Tin Man Games, said: “We’ve been one of the digital custodians of the [i]Fighting Fantasy[/i] license for a number of years now and feel that it’s about time that the original fans, as well as newcomers, are able to play the classics on their smartphones and tablets. We’ve updated our old gamebook engine and plan to release a large number of the gamebooks that players will be able to purchase within the one app.”

New releases will be staggered across the next 18 months and will include [i]Deathtrap Dungeon, Sword of the Samurai[/i] and [i]Creature of Havoc[/i] amongst many others. Where possible Tin Man Games will use the original artwork from the gamebooks as well as adding new illustrations to bring the interactive adventures to life.

Neil continued: “We also have plans to include lots of extras over time, including music options, new dice designs and page skins. There are a lot of titles in the original collection that have never been re-published, so it’s a very exciting time for [i]Fighting Fantasy[/i] fans!”

[i]Fighting Fantasy Classics[/i] will be available to download in February 2018 for iOS and Android. It will also be available on PC and Mac via Steam a few months later.

notes.title: Unlock a New Legends Figurine! Steam Community Event!
notes.content:
[h1]Oriana the Soulkeeper Gold Figurine - work with other players and decipher the unlock code![/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25736678/de1fce6fb9fd44c808af8d1010457eb2bb31a540.jpg[/img]

We've just added a new [b]Legends[/b] figurine collection to the latest update of [b]The Warlock of Firetop Mountain[/b]. Over the next few months we'll be releasing special figurines that can be used in the [b]Goblin Gauntlet[/b]. 

Our first release is [b]Oriana[/b], the keeper of Souls! YOU must work together with other players to decipher a code phrase hidden within Firetop Mountain. Once you have the phrase completed you can enter it to unlock her figurine. Check the forums to share codes and slowly build up the special phrase, which has a very [b]Fighting Fantasy[/b] flavour!

RULES

1) Play as any one of the fifteen base heroes in the game.

2) Complete the quest related to the hero.

3) Oriana will give you three numbers separated with a dash like this: X-X-X

4) The three numbers reference a word from the title of one of the original Fighting Fantasy books released by Puffin Books between 1982 and 1995. [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_Fighting_Fantasy_gamebooks]The comprehensive wiki list can be found here.[/url]

The first number relates to the order of the words within the phrase.
The second number relates to book number in the list.
The third number relates to the word in the book title.

For example, the word relating to 10-5-3 would reference the 3rd word 'Thieves' from the title of FF book 5. It would then be the 10th word in the code phrase.

5) Share your code on the forums in the following thread: http://steamcommunity.com/app/324740/discussions/0/1483232961045251521/

5) Once all fifteen words have been deciphered, enter the phrase with spaces to unlock the figurine!

GOOD LUCK ADVENTURERS!


[h1]Patch v7070 Notes[/h1]
- Changed layout of main menu and character selection, splitting character groups into 'Story' and 'Gauntlet' modes. Previous saves will not be overriden until you have selected a character.
- Some improvements have been made to scene loading times.

notes.title: Goblin Scourge Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1] Save game news, and Free Souls! [/h1]
We have reworked our save system to solve our Steam Cloud issue as the previous fix caused issues with users playing on multiple computers. Please contact us if you still have problems saving [b]after updating to this latest patch. Please ensure you're running the latest patch before running the game.[/b] 

Due to this some players have lost progress through the mountain. To help get everyone back on their feet, we've added a way to 'cash in' codes for souls. In this update, the options menu has an 'Enter Code' button: select this and enter [b]IMAGOBLIN[/b] to gain 300 souls immediately!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25736678/091e70eb8b486ff423f7999fa2b07f9a3750739b.png[/img]

We have also added a 'Load from Local' button. [b]If you still have problems with Steam Cloud saves, you can press this to load a backup local save that isn't synced to Steam Cloud.[/b] This is only for emergency use as it will override your main local save, so use it only if you have entered the game again and find yourself with less souls or missing characters. [b]This will only work for saved games lost in this latest update.[/b]

[h1] Patch Notes [/h1]

- Fixed the steam cloud saving bugs

- Fixed a Linux library issue

- Fixed a interface problem with selecting the DLC characters with a gamepad. We are working on fixing other gamepad issues in a later patch.

notes.title: Survive the Goblin Scourge!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25736678/50111c43d978449e35f98a42e75dfeff4b072abb.jpg[/img]

[url=store.steampowered.com/app/484970/] Get the Goblin Scourge [/url] to unlock three new heroes, six playable monsters and an explosive new location.

The sound of scurrying feet fills the caverns of Firetop Mountain... the Goblin Scourge is unleashed! Play as three characters journeying through the lair of the goblins and uncover the bizarre rituals and plots of their horde.

[h1] The Goblin Gauntlet  [/h1]
As part of the Goblin Scourge pack are six playable characters based on monsters found throughout Firetop Mountain. These monsters will journey through a streamlined version of the mountain known as the Goblin Gauntlet, where death is permanent and souls are plenty.

[h1] Save game Warning  [/h1]
Due to a Steam problem pre-release, the first few playthroughs of new and old players alike may have problems saving at resting benches. This bug is fixed but may take time to propagate from Steam's saving system. [b] A clear sign that this bug will affect you is if the resurrection stones in your inventory are greyed out and unable to be used.[/b] 

This save file bug should sort itself out but may be a problem for a short time - [b] Closing and reopening Steam should force the save files to refresh.[/b]

[h1] Other Fixes [/h1]
[list]
    [*]Added a "Character" button to the main menu. This allows you to browse characters without overwriting your saved game.
    [*]Reworked Twenty-Three's attacks.
    [*]Fixed an audio issue where ambient sound would continue to play after SFX had been turned off.
    [*]Fixed an issue where players would be given 6 resurrection stones.
    [*]Fixed some issues with character pathing.
[/list]

notes.title: Controller Support Update
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that The Warlock of Firetop Mountain now features controller support! If you attended PAX Aus, you would have had a sneak preview, but we've found and squashed a few more bugs since then.

By default, the game will select Xbox Controller functionality, but if you prefer to use a Steam Controller, we recommend that you set the 'Gamepad Type' to Steam Controller for the best experience. This setting can be found under the 'Game' tab in Settings:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25736678/ebbb48b0cbe15d22976731d24f67c254ed67adb8.png[/img]

We hope that you continue to enjoy the game, and the best of luck in your travels through Firetop Mountain. May your STAMINA never fail!

The Allansian Wanderers update includes a Linux version of the game, three new playable heroes to choose from, and more!

[b]FEATURES[/b]
[list]
    [*]Three new playable characters, with new stories, combat moves and achievements
    [*]Linux version of the game
    [*]Art Gallery to keep track of illustrations you have seen
    [*]A new feature detailing the History of Fighting Fantasy from the 1980s to today
    [*]Timeline of Fighting Fantasy paperback releases
[/list]
[b]UPDATES[/b]
[list]
    [*]Additional checkpoint benches to give you the upper hand against Zagor's devious traps
    [*]Decreased the amount of souls required to purchase new heroes
    [*]Optimizations to make more efficient use of hard disk space
[/list]
[b]NEW HEROES[/b]
[h1]Lin Wen-Wu[/h1]
This reluctant warrior wishes to avenge his brother, who lost his sword arm in combat with an Orc Chieftain who makes his home in Firetop Mountain.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25736678/15b8b824ab0ab61a638655af5d239fc7aa0a77d0.png[/img]

[h1]Malleus Malleus[/h1]
A famed gladiator severely wounded by a werewolf, Malleus Malleus is cursed with lycanthropy. He must seek the werewolf before the curse cannot be cured.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25736678/f512c2982f2fa2fb4c0c98b520c7b82aa473f461.png[/img]

[h1]Lynette Hurtado[/h1]
Lynette is a guardian of the temple of the Goddess of Justice and Truth. Citizens have requested her assistance in their resistance against the cruel tyranny of the Warlock, Zagor.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25736678/c8e93f97671431ae72e4f8768011e814eec3aad8.png[/img]

Many thanks from everyone at Tin Man Games.
